# GitHub Copilot

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing this repository. It is the canonical brief (editions, Office.js, auth, SSE, backend, secrets).

Do not add `Word.run` outside `src/office/`. Do not write tokens or keys to `Office.Settings`. Do not put `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` in the pane or Vite build args. Do not commit unless the user asks.
